Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “original voice” to mean the pilot’s first chronological voice (Rachael MacFarlane) instead of the widely accepted original/main-series voice before Mila Kunis (Lacey Chabert). This misreading of the question’s intent led toward the wrong conclusion despite sources confirming Lacey Chabert as the original main-series voice of Meg.
